transcript.text: Maya, before you finalize, I want to make sure we're thinking through the legacy reporting worker issue carefully. The patch breaks that worker's signed CSV export unless the compatibility switch is enabled, and the switch won't be ready until Monday at 10:00 AM. If we proceed with the rollout on Saturday, any signed CSV exports from that legacy worker will be broken from the time the patch hits those nodes until Monday at 10:00 AM. I'm not sure an 'exception' fully addresses this — we need to understand whether any customers or downstream processes depend on those signed CSV exports between Saturday and Monday. If they do, we may need to either hold the patch on the nodes running that worker until Monday, or explicitly accept the breakage as a known impact. I'll file the compatibility ticket as a commitment, but I want to flag that the scope of impact isn't fully clear yet.
